scope: Follow-up to 86 survivors in complete campaign v2; complete campaign v3 finished and failed

review.finding: Default-only metadata fixtures did not distinguish parsed conversion limits from replacement with ConversionLimits::default().
review.contract: Nine nondefault limits survive reading exactly; an invalid zero step budget is rejected.

review.finding: Compound name and hex checks need independent invalid operands; generic is_err assertions do not establish typed errors.
review.contract: Empty/NUL keys, short/long/uppercase float-bit hex, nested arrays and JSON floating values return their specified metadata reason.

review.finding: Later layout errors can mask skipped catalog checks; tests must isolate the intended validation.
review.contract: Counts and NUL names return specific format errors. A tensor-index tail with consistently relocated sections, block payload offsets and recomputed hashes is rejected.

review.finding: A trivially tiny memory cap does not prove that synthesis scratch is charged.
review.contract: A one-weight source exceeds a 1 MiB cap independently through configured step scratch and retained synthesis bits.

review.finding: Generic limit failure does not identify source preflight accounting versus later output accounting.
review.contract: Reported required bytes equal independently counted GGUF metadata and descriptor lengths before publication.

complete_campaign_v3.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo mutants -p bml-model-weights --all-features --cargo-arg=--locked --test-workspace false --jobs 2 --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300 --output target/model-weights-mutations-v3
